request: Evaluate whether an external orchestration tool should be adopted for a GAMEROAD current-state workflow, without replacing Drive authority or claiming product progress from a control-plane experiment.
current_authority: Drive CURRENT requires current authority first, direct actual evidence, counterevidence, owner/lock safety, execution, verification, readback, and separation of control-plane results from product progress. Existing KnowledgeCompiler keeps Drive as the only authority and treats derived indexes as non-authoritative.
direct_actual: Official repo rathersitooo-ux/GMR default branch is main. Fresh main HEAD at experiment start is 7cf15870dd3c8308edecde24100ddd39082ffc0a. Another active WorkUnit currently owns browser/GAMEROAD.html and a separate workflow path, so this experiment uses only new isolated paths. Pipelex upstream main release commit 42139f7588cd5ad594296a45f9e89caff6cbc639 identifies v0.51.0; its README documents typed reusable .mthds methods and Codex integration.
counterevidence: Local pip installation could not reach PyPI because the execution sandbox has DNS/network restrictions. This does not prove Pipelex is broken. Adding Pipelex as a second authority or silently replacing CURRENT would violate the project authority model. A dry-run can prove syntax, type/data-flow wiring, and fail-closed validation, but cannot prove live LLM answer quality or production benefit.
